docs.title: Kitchens
docs.text: Kitchens we designed, built and installed in homes in and around Ashdod. Every kitchen on this page was made in our workshop.
f: Made-to-measure kitchens from our Ashdod workshop
Кухни по размерам из нашей мастерской в Ашдоде
Kitchens we designed, built and installed in homes in and around Ashdod. Every kitchen on this page was made in our workshop.

A kitchen is the room you work in most, so we plan it around your home, not a catalogue. In our Ashdod workshop we have built straight, L-shaped and U-shaped kitchens, kitchens with an island or a breakfast bar, and small kitchenettes, one of them hidden behind folding doors.

Fronts change from project to project: handleless white gloss, colours such as cream, cappuccino, champagne, green and purple, wood-look fronts, and classic or country kitchens with framed doors and glazed cabinets. Many clients chose printed glass for the backsplash or an upper door.

What is inside the cabinets matters just as much: pull-out corner baskets, internal drawers, a pantry with baskets, an appliance cabinet with a roller shutter, a hood hidden in an upper cabinet. We choose these together when planning.
It starts with measuring in your home, then the design and quote. Once you approve, the kitchen is built in our workshop and installed at your place.
It suits people moving into a new home, families replacing an old kitchen, and small flats where every cabinet has to work hard. Bring photos of kitchens you like to the meeting.

A ready-made kitchen is usually cheaper and quicker, and sometimes that is enough. A workshop kitchen is built to your walls, pipes and appliances, so no space is wasted. We work mainly in Ashdod, Ashkelon and the surrounding area, and in parts of the Center.

docs.title: Wall closets
docs.text: Closets for bedrooms, niches and corners, floor to ceiling. Measured at your home and built in our Ashdod workshop.
f: Wall closets built to fit your room
Closets for bedrooms, niches and corners, floor to ceiling. Measured at your home and built in our Ashdod workshop.

A good wall closet uses the whole wall, floor to ceiling, and fits the room rather than the other way round. In our Ashdod workshop we build bedroom closets, niche closets, corner closets and tall narrow cabinets for bathrooms.

On this page you will find white floor-to-ceiling closets with metal handles, mirrored sliding doors, walnut combined with white doors, a matt light closet with aluminium profile handles, and cream framed fronts with brass knobs. Inside we fit open shelves, angled shoe shelves, drawers or a glass-shelf display unit.
Sliding doors suit a narrow room because they need no space to open. Hinged doors open the whole closet at once. We help you choose by room size and what you will store.
We measure at your home, check walls, ceiling and sockets, and plan the inside with you. The closet is built in the workshop and installed by us.
It suits rooms with uneven walls, unusual ceiling heights or an air conditioner in the way, and children's rooms whose needs change over the years.

A ready-made closet is cheaper and quicker, but it comes in fixed sizes and often leaves gaps above or at the sides. A made-to-measure closet fills the wall. We work mainly in Ashdod, Ashkelon and the surrounding area, and in parts of the Center.

docs.title: Walk-in closets
docs.text: All your clothes, shoes and bags in one place, in a room planned for you and built in our Ashdod workshop.
f: All your clothes, shoes and bags in one place, in a room planned for you and built in our Ashdod workshop.
A walk-in closet keeps clothes, shoes and bags in one place and frees the bedroom from cabinets. Even a small or narrow room can work well if it is planned properly.

Here you will find open walk-ins we built in oak, dark wood and walnut tones, all with full-height shelves, hanging space and drawers. In one we fitted pull-down hanging rails so the top of the wall can be used without a ladder. In a narrow one we planned double-height hanging and a low chest with a top.

Planning starts with what you own: how many long and short items, how many pairs of shoes, who uses the room. The walls are then divided between hanging, shelves and drawers. The room can be fully open or have doors.

After measuring you get a design and a quote. We build every part in the workshop and assemble it at your home. For some projects we photographed the whole way, from drawing or empty room to the finished closet.
It suits couples who share the space, families who have outgrown a standard closet, and anyone building a house who wants a dedicated dressing room.

Ready-made walk-in systems come in a few fixed sizes. When the room has a window, an air conditioner, a sloped wall or an odd corner, made-to-measure carpentry uses the space better. We work mainly in Ashdod, Ashkelon and the surrounding area, and in parts of the Center.

docs.title: Sideboards and TV units
docs.text: Wall-hung and standing sideboards, TV walls and chests, built to fit your wall in our Ashdod workshop.
f: Sideboards and TV units made to measure
Wall-hung and standing sideboards, TV walls and chests, built to fit your wall in our Ashdod workshop.
A sideboard or TV wall is the first thing you see in the living room. Built to measure, it sits exactly on the wall, the cables are hidden and every device has its place.

We have built wall-hung sideboards, units on metal or slim legs, a long two-level sideboard and units with a built-in electric fireplace under the TV. In some homes we also clad the TV wall, for example in dark walnut with a recessed frame for the screen.
Finishes on this page: handleless white gloss, light grey with a dark top, oak with sage green, greyish wood. Inside we plan wide drawers, doors, open niches and a tidy route for cables.
Sometimes it starts with a hand sketch. We measure the wall, check the sockets and TV point, and plan height and length. A wall-hung unit needs a suitable wall, so we check it in advance.
It suits a long living-room wall, a wall with a window or column, and homes with many devices. If you plan to change the TV soon, tell us the new screen size.

A ready-made sideboard has a fixed length. A made-to-measure one can fill a whole wall, work around a column or window and suit your screen size. We work mainly in Ashdod, Ashkelon and the surrounding area, and in parts of the Center.

docs.title: Bathroom vanities
docs.text: Wall-hung and standing vanities, tall storage units and over-toilet cabinets, made to the size of your bathroom.
f: Wall-hung and standing vanities, tall storage units and over-toilet cabinets, made to the size of your bathroom.
A bathroom is usually small with awkward dimensions: fixed plumbing, a washing machine, a window or a corner. A made-to-measure vanity makes full use of that space.

We have built wall-hung vanities with drawers, units with open towel shelves, tall storage columns, a cabinet over the toilet and one next to the washing machine. You will see white fronts with a dark wood top, a green vanity with a black top and an old-rose basin, a natural wood vanity with a black basin and tap, and a rounded triangular basin. Some were designed with an in-house designer.
In a wet room the material matters: the cabinet has to cope with steam and splashes. Choose the basin, top and tap together with the cabinet so sizes and colours match.
We measure at home, including pipes and drain, then design, build and install. A wall-hung vanity keeps the floor clear and easy to clean; a standing one gives more storage.

It suits small bathrooms, guest toilets that need a shallow cabinet, and anyone who wants the vanity to match the rest of the home. If you are renovating, talk to us before the plumber fixes the pipe positions.

A ready-made vanity comes in fixed widths and often leaves an awkward gap. A made-to-measure one fills the wall exactly. We work mainly in Ashdod, Ashkelon and the surrounding area, and in parts of the Center.

docs.title: Offices and studies
docs.text: Desks, bookcases and work corners that fit the room and the person working in it, from our Ashdod workshop.
f: Made-to-measure furniture for offices and studies
ריהוט לפי מידה למשרדים ולחדרי עבודה
Мебель по размерам для кабинетов и офисов
Desks, bookcases and work corners that fit the room and the person working in it, from our Ashdod workshop.
A good workspace needs room for a computer, paperwork and books without taking over the room. We build made-to-measure furniture for offices and home studies.

Projects here include a large L-shaped executive desk with a curved front in glossy wood with black edging and drawer units on castors; a home study with a floor-to-ceiling oak bookcase and matching desk; a warm wood study with glass-door upper cabinets and a glass-top desk; a built-in white work corner with red edging; and a child's room unit with a desk, drawers and shelves.

We plan for the person who sits there every day: desk height, legroom, cable routes, sockets and what needs to be within reach. Often the desk and a bookcase are combined on one wall as a single unit.
As with all our work, we measure on site, design, build in the workshop and install.

It suits people working from home, children who need a homework desk, and offices that want a desk, bookcase or cabinets fitted to the room. We also plan for light, so a window does not glare on the screen.

Ready-made office furniture is available at once and suits many spaces. When there is an odd corner or a whole wall for books, made-to-measure solves it. We work mainly in Ashdod, Ashkelon and the surrounding area, and in parts of the Center.

docs.text: Every piece here was built in our Ashdod workshop and installed in a client's home. Pick a category or scroll through them all.

docs.title: A family workshop in Ashdod
docs.text: For more than 30 years we have been building made-to-measure furniture for homes in and around Ashdod. Shalito Carpentry is a family business in Ashdod, run by Michael (Misha) Shalito, a carpenter with more than 30 years of experience. For more than 30 years we have worked with families in Ashdod and the area, building their kitchens, closets and furniture to measure. Our workshop is at Nachoshet 2, Ashdod. Every piece you see on this site was built here, from cutting to assembly, before it went out to be installed. Michael (Misha) Shalito leads the work in the workshop. On some projects, such as bathroom vanities, an in-house designer worked with us so the design suits the whole room, not just the cabinet. We measure in your home, plan with you, build in our own workshop and install ourselves. From the first call to installation you deal with the same people. The quote is free.

docs.title: How it works, step by step
docs.text: Six steps from your first message to the furniture standing in your home. First contact: Send us photos of the space and rough measurements on WhatsApp, or call. That way we understand what you need before we meet. Meeting and measuring at home: We come to you, take exact measurements, check walls, pipes and sockets, and hear how you use the space. Design and quote: Together we plan the layout, materials, finish and hardware. You get a free quote, and we only start building after you approve. Production in the workshop: The furniture is built in our Ashdod workshop to the measurements taken in your home. Installation: We deliver and install ourselves, adjust doors and drawers and check with you that everything works. We tell you in advance what must be ready. Warranty and service: If anything needs adjusting or fixing after installation, just contact us.

docs.title: Accessibility statement
docs.text: We want everyone to be able to use this site, including people with disabilities. The site was built according to the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 2013, and Israeli Standard IS 5568, which is based on WCAG 2.1. The site was built to conform with level AA of IS 5568 and WCAG 2.1, except for the limitations listed below. Clear structure: headings in order, marked navigation regions and a defined language on every page (Hebrew right-to-left, English and Russian left-to-right). Keyboard: every link, button and form field can be reached with the keyboard, with a clearly visible focus indicator and a skip-to-content link at the top of each page. Photo viewer: move between photos with the arrow keys or the "previous" and "next" buttons, which are also shown on phones, and close it with Esc or the close button. Colour contrast: text and buttons meet the AA contrast ratio. Images: every image has alternative text describing what it shows. Decorative images are marked so screen readers skip them. Forms: every field has a label, and error messages are written in words and linked to the right field. Zoom: text can be enlarged to 200% without losing content, and the layout adapts to narrow screens without sideways scrolling. Motion: if you have turned on reduced motion on your device, the site's animations stop. We did not install an accessibility overlay widget. Accessibility is built into the site's own code, and you can use your browser's and operating system's tools. The alternative texts of project photos are a first draft, and we are improving them gradually. Some older photos are low quality, so small details are hard to see. If you find another problem, please tell us. Measuring and meetings usually take place at the customer's home. If you need a special arrangement to visit the workshop, call us at 054-8099762 and we will arrange it together. If something on the site is not accessible to you, call us at 054-8099762 or message us on WhatsApp. We will help you get the information and fix the problem. To help us, tell us which page it was, what you tried to do and which device and browser you used. We will get back to you as soon as we can. This statement was last updated in October 2026.

docs.title: Privacy policy
docs.text: This site belongs to Shalito Carpentry, Nachoshet 2, Ashdod, phone 054-8099762. This page explains what information we collect on the site and what we do with it. When you fill in the form we receive what you wrote: name, phone, town, type of project, your message, and photos if you chose to attach them. The details are sent to us by email. We use these details only to answer your request and give you a quote. We do not sell or rent them, and we do not send you advertising without your consent. If you would like us to delete a request you sent, call or message us and we will delete it. We use Google Analytics 4 to understand which pages interest visitors and how people contact us, and Google Ads to measure the results of our advertising. They run only after you agree in the cookie notice, and one agreement covers both. Until you accept, nothing from Google loads on the site and no statistics or ad measurement cookies are stored on your device. What is collected: pages visited, device and browser type, approximate region, how you reached the site, and clicks on phone, WhatsApp and form submission. We do not send Google the name, phone or message you wrote in the form. Google keeps the data according to the retention settings of our Google Analytics and Google Ads accounts. With your consent Google may link a visit to a Google ad you clicked, to measure advertising results. How to withdraw consent: click "Cookie settings" at the bottom of any page and choose not to allow. From then on statistics and ad measurement stop. To block spam in the form we use Cloudflare Turnstile. It checks that the form is sent by a person, not a bot, and for that it processes technical data such as IP address and browser details. It is not used for advertising. More information is in Cloudflare's privacy policy. Under Israel's Privacy Protection Law, 1981, you may ask to see the information we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it if it is wrong, incomplete or out of date. For any privacy request or question, call 054-8099762 or message us on WhatsApp. Last updated: October 2026.
